2 & forward heading offline (1B) & only the UKF and FGO receive the camera heading; EKF3 none & EKF3 is the fixed no-yaw-source baseline (VISO\_YAW\_M\_NSE floor; LOG\_REPLAY=0) & ruling M:2884-2888 \\
3 & closed-loop heading $\sigma$ (1C) & all three at 5\textdegree{}; the camera's own $\sigma$ (0.148\textdegree{}) is not usable by EKF3 & 5\textdegree{} is ArduPilot's floor (VISO\_YAW\_M\_NSE 0.05); ruled that the UKF port applies the same 5\textdegree{} & M:4896; ruling M:7553 \\

7 & ground-proximity flow rule & EKF3's rule (flow zeroed and still fused below 0.5 m before take-off) applied to the UKF and FGO & a sensor-validity rule, shared (not tuning) & ruling M:7038; M:7060 \\
8 & EKF3's pre-arm yaw-bias learning & EKF3 learns gyro-z bias on the ground; not given to the UKF or FGO & principle: sensor-validity rules are shared, design features are not copied; a caveat on the no-heading closed loop only & M:7785-7792; PROGRESS.md:47 \\
9 & EKF3 range median-of-3, tilt cut, floor & EKF3 only & EKF3 design, not copied & M:8871 \\

12 & FGO biasAccOmegaInt & was diag(0.2$^2$, 0.043633$^2$): extra IMU white noise (gyro \textasciitilde{}26$\times$, accel \textasciitilde{}5$\times$ looser); set to 0 & a model correction (a sensor-noise error) & ruling M:12046; M:12052; FC:35 \\
13 & UKF Cholesky jitter & both builds added 1e-12$\cdot$I to P before every Cholesky; now jitter is added only if the factorisation fails (ladder 0, 1e-12, 1e-9, 1e-6) & a model correction & M:12329; ruling M:12343; UC:57 \\
14 & UKF flow derotation & the UKF derotates flow with the bias-corrected rate & a model correction, not a copied design feature & ruling M:11366 \\

16 & flow validity & every estimator accepts flow on the same binary validity flag (feature count), no R-scaling & ruled: flow validity uses the feature count only & M:8936; FGO\_DESIGN.md:424 \\
17 & IMU gap rule & replays of the UKF and FGO start after / exclude IMU gaps; EKF3 (live) is still scored & ruling (2026-09-24), extended & M:1985; M:2487 \\
18 & tag-fix gating (Exp. 2--5) & EKF3 gates tag fixes (position 5$\sigma$, yaw 3$\sigma$, bypassed after a 10 s timeout); the UKF and FGO do not gate them & pre-registered; validity is the shared tag rule (a sensor-validity rule) & M:10066; M:10134; M:11613 \\
19 & GNSS on return (Exp. 4) & the UKF and FGO fuse the GNSS samples EKF3 received, ungated, and on return simply resume (no reset or variance inflation); EKF3 behaves by its own design & EKF3 design, not copied; no gate, as in Exp. 2 & M:10336; M:10337 \\
20 & FGO: no yaw reset at the first heading & the FGO fuses the first heading with no reset & design feature, not copied & M:8043 \\
